planted_controls: Rule 3 and prereg section 9. ELEVEN controls, all run BEFORE the measurement counts; the checkMesh set runs before ANY compute, so a control failure costs zero core-minutes. checkMesh reader: C1 the `=` label form yields a non-null max aspect ratio; C2 the `:` form does too (a reader matching only `=` sees 745 of this box's 885 logs and silently misses exactly the 140 pathological ones -- measured); C3 Min volume != Max volume gives a non-trivial derived cell-volume ratio, never 1; C4 THE VERDICT-LINE TRAP on a real production artifact that says `check OK` at 84.6437 deg, which the reader must report as above_70; C5 a 12.3456 planted into a scratch copy on disk is read back exactly; C6 an absent log reads ABSENT and yields no number, never clean; C7 a truncated log REFUSES rather than degrades; C8 a genuine 0.0 reads as 0.0 and is distinguishable from ABSENT -- C4/C5 are what make a zero from this reader evidence at all. Grid reader: P1 every PLOT3D token is consumed; P2 a 2.5e-05 m displacement planted on disk MOVES the first-cell-height reading; P3 the cell count does NOT move under it. All eleven were run green against real artifacts before this entry was written.
falsifiability_guard: SINGLE CONNECTED REGION IS A COMPLETION CLAUSE. plot3dToFoam converts a NINE-BLOCK PLOT3D grid; had it failed to merge the coincident block-interface points, those interfaces would become BOUNDARY faces, and checkMesh computes non-orthogonality over INTERNAL faces only -- so every block interface would drop out of the statistic and the reported maximum would be FALSELY OPTIMISTIC. The driver refuses on anything but `Number of regions: 1`. Independently, the PLOT3D block-header cell arithmetic and checkMesh's own census must agree on 143,520.
